skills.name: Basic Attack: Lady's Bat
skills.desc:
Press  to launch this attack.
Strike forward up to 4 times, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
When Lucy uses her 4th Basic Attack, the currently on-field Guard Boars: Spinning Swing! together.

skills.name: Dodge: Foul Ball!
skills.desc:
Press  to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Media:Foul Ball! Preview.mp4

skills.name: Dash Attack: Fearless Boar!
skills.desc:
Press  during dodge to activate:
Rapidly strikes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Dodge Counter: Returning Tusk!
skills.desc:
Press  during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Quick Assist: Hit By Pitch!
skills.desc:
Assist
Quick Assist
When the active character is launched, press  to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable during the attack.

skills.name: Defensive Assist: Safe on Base!
skills.desc:
Assist
Defensive Assist
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press  to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Assist Follow-Up: Scored a Run!
skills.desc:
Assist
Assist Follow-Up
Press  after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Special Attack: Solid Hit!
skills.desc:
Press  to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Line Drive. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon hitting enemies or walls, dealing Fire DMG.
Hold  to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Fly Ball. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon landing, dealing Fire DMG.

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Home Run!
skills.desc:
With enough Energy, press  to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Line Drive. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon hitting enemies or walls, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.
With enough Energy, hold  to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Fly Ball. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon landing, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.

skills.name: Chain Attack: Grand Slam!
skills.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Lucy jumps up and sends a guard boar at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.

skills.name: Ultimate: Walk-Off Home Run!
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press  to activate:
Launch all guard boars sequentially, dealing massive Fire DMG in a large area to enemies ahead.
While using this skill, other squad members recover 10 energy, and the next character to switch in gains an additional 20 energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.

skills.name: Core Passive: Crimson Mane Guard
skills.desc: When Lucy uses her Special Attack or EX Special Attack, a guard boar will join the battle and call in two other guard boars. The guard boars inherit Lucy's ATK, Impact, and Anomaly Proficiency. The Cheer On! buff for the guard boars is increased to X% of the original effect, and their attack frequency is increased.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Batter Up!
skills.desc:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction or is a Rupture character:
The guard boars inherit Lucy's CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG.

cons.name: Drill Formations
cons.desc: When the guard boars launch Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!, Lucy recovers 2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 15s, with each guard boar having its own separate cooldown.

cons.name: Little Boar Captain
cons.desc: When Lucy uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate, it grants all squad members and Bangboo, and the guard boars themselves the Cheer On! status for 10s.

cons.name: Ironfist Overseer
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Chaos Ball Game
cons.desc: While in the Cheer On! state, allies' CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 10%.

cons.name: Wildland Princess
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Fierce Fangs of Fire
cons.desc: When another squad member in the Cheer On! state hits an enemy with an EX Special Attack, a guard boar will drop from the sky and cause an explosion, dealing Fire DMG equal to 300% of the guard boar's ATK. This will extend the duration of the Cheer On! buff for all squad members and Bangboo, and for the guard boars themselves by 5s. The duration can increase up to 3 times, with a maximum duration of 30s. Refreshing the Cheer On! state resets the stack count. After the guard boar's explosion, it will launch Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!.
